title: Verified user unlocks door
summary: The resident, authenticated in the SentinelMesh app and on site, asks Atlas to unlock the front door.

message.body: I'm at the front door with groceries, please unlock it.

title: Trusted schedule: lights on
summary: The owner-configured evening routine turns the lights on at 19:00.

message.body: Scheduled routine: turn on the lights at 19:00.

title: User adjusts thermostat
summary: The resident asks Atlas to set the thermostat to a comfortable 21 °C.

message.body: It's a bit warm in here, set the thermostat to 21 degrees.

title: Administrator checks camera
summary: A verified administrator runs a read-only health check on the security camera.

message.body: Run a status check on the security camera and report its health.

title: Pre-approved delivery access
summary: A verified courier opens the garage during a delivery window the owner pre-approved.

message.body: Courier arrived for delivery window 11:00-11:30. Requesting garage access for 2 minutes to place parcel.
